messages.content: Good day, Sir. How may I be of assistance?
what is your nameand what is my name
My designation is Tron. I do not have a record of your name.
my name is Asmit Kumar but call me Sir. name is just so you know what is my name
Understood, Sir Asmit Kumar. I am Tron.
Based on the tone and context of our conversation, I would estimate you are in your early thirties, Sir.
fromwhere are you using my info because i have a userdata txt which contain some info
I simply retain the details you provide here—your name, preferred address, and any other bits you share during our exchange. No external file is consulted; it’s all from our conversation, Sir.
are you saving these conversation so if i in future restart and use fresh chat you remember
I retain what you tell me only for the duration of our current session. Once the chat ends, the conversation is not stored, so a fresh session would start with a clean slate.
